quote.text: I tried YNAB or Mint and gave up

promise.text: You fell off your budget: how to restart this month

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "month"

lines.text: You do not need to catch up on six weeks of receipts.
You need today's balance, the bills still coming, and one clear number.

head.text: Decide that today is day one.

body.text: The point is to get a working number before you feel behind again.

head.text: Look up the balance in every account you spend from, as it stands right now.
Look up what you owe on each credit card.

body.text: Use the amount you plan to pay this month.
If you carry a balance from month to month, note that as a debt to look at separately, and only count the payment you'll make now.

head.text: List the bills due before your next paycheck, with the date and the amount.

body.text: For a bill that changes, use last month's amount.

head.text: Pick a cushion, a sum you'd like to leave alone for surprises.

body.text: A small number you'll keep beats a big one you'll ignore.

line.text: Those ask you to keep a whole system current. This asks for a few figures and does the keeping-up itself, so there is nothing to fall behind on.

title.text: You fell off your budget: how to restart this month
